title: How many molecules in a drop?
hook: One drop of water. How many H₂O molecules are in it?

knows: that a mole is a huge count
doesNotKnow: how many molecules sit in one everyday drop

misconception: A drop holds millions or billions of molecules.
objective: The learner can say that a drop of water holds about 1.7 × 10²¹ molecules, about 200 billion times the number of people on Earth, and that grouping by thousands still leaves a billion tiles after four steps.

claims.text: A drop of water is about 0.05 mL, which is about 0.05 g.
claims.source: Pharmacopoeia convention of about 20 drops per mL; density of water about 0.998 g/mL at 20 °C (CRC Handbook). Real drops vary with the dropper.

claims.text: The molar mass of water is about 18.015 g/mol and the Avogadro constant is 6.02214076 × 10²³ per mole.
claims.source: IUPAC atomic weights (H 1.008, O 15.999); SI 2019 Avogadro constant.

claims.text: A 0.05 mL drop of water is about 0.0028 mol (0.05 g ÷ 18 g per mole) and contains about 1.7 × 10²¹ H₂O molecules.
claims.source: 0.05 mL x 0.998 g/mL / 18.015 g/mol = 2.77e-3 mol; x 6.02214e23 = 1.668e21 (node; Demo.tsx MOLECULES). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 13): node: 0.05 x 0.998 / 18.015 = 2.77e-3 mol; x 6.02214076e23 = 1.668e21. Matches Demo.tsx MOLECULES.

claims.text: Grouping molecules into tiles of 10¹² still leaves about 1.7 × 10⁹ tiles; tiles of 10²¹ leave about 1.7.
1.7 × 10²¹ molecules is about 2 × 10¹¹ (200 billion) times the number of people on Earth, taken as about 8 billion.
claims.source: 1.668e21 / 8e9 = 2.09e11 (node). World population about 8 × 10⁹ (UN World Population Prospects 2022: 8.0 billion in November 2022). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 13): node: 1.668e21 / 8e9 = 2.09e11, "about 2 x 10^11". UN WPP 2022 marked 8.0 billion on 15 Nov 2022.

claims.text: Only the final two grouping steps draw tiles; earlier steps show a dotted texture because there are too many tiles to draw.
claims.source: Demo.tsx drawable = step >= 6; the texture is decoration, not a count.

recall.question: One drop of water holds about 1.7 × 10²¹ molecules. Roughly how does that compare with the number of people on Earth (about 8 billion)?
options: About a thousand times as many
